async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to project details using the knowledge base function
    project_name = "Byte Blaze / a11y-syntax-highlighting"
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, project_name)
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 2: Click on the Issues link to go to the issues page
    # Assuming the issues link is in the project navigation
    issues_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Issues')
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 3: Click the 'New issue' button
    new_issue_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='New issue')
    await new_issue_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 4: Fill in the issue title and description
    title_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title')
    await title_textbox.fill('Connection refused in ChatGPT')
    
    description_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description')
    await description_textbox.fill('Issue: Connection refused when trying to access ChatGPT. Please investigate.')
    
    # Step 5: Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Submit issue')
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 6: Retrieve the issue URL or confirmation
    # Assuming the issue page loads with a unique URL or element
    # Print the current URL as the result
    issue_url = page.url
    print(f"Issue created at: {issue_url}")
    return issue_url
